addons.title: Ancestral Welcome in Cusco
addons.shortDescription: Begin your stay with a panoramic route, an Andean ceremony and memorable views of Cusco.

addons.title: Humantay Lake
addons.shortDescription: Hike to the turquoise lake at the foot of snowcapped Humantay, one of Cusco’s most impressive excursions.

addons.title: Vinicunca Rainbow Mountain
addons.shortDescription: See the Andes’ famous rainbow-colored mountain on a full-day excursion from Cusco.
includes: Professional guide in English or Spanish
Breakfast and lunch according to the operating plan
addons.excludesNote: Local admission and the optional horse are not included unless expressly confirmed.

addons.title: Sacred Valley of the Incas
addons.shortDescription: Explore Pisac, Urubamba, Ollantaytambo and Chinchero on a complete cultural route through the Sacred Valley.
includes: Professional guide in English or Spanish
Return to Cusco at the end of the tour

addons.title: Seven Lakes of Ausangate
